hook: Is she the most dominant athlete of all time? Four hundred and seventy straight wins.
story: Her name is Esther Vergeer. A nine-hour spinal operation at age eight left her legs paralyzed; she found tennis in rehab. By seventeen she was world number one. In January 2003, she lost a match in Sydney. She never lost again. Not for ten years: one hundred and twenty straight tournaments, seven Paralympic golds, forty-three Grand Slam titles, six hundred and sixty-eight weeks at number one.
number: Four hundred and fifty-two of those four hundred and seventy wins never even reached a deciding set. The longest streak anyone has managed in standing tennis is seventy-four. And in ten years of matches, her opponents earned exactly one match point. One. The Beijing Paralympic final, 2008. She saved it, took the gold, and no one ever got that close again.
closer: She retired at thirty-one, still world number one. Nobody ever ended the streak.
